title: Sudoku Solver

solutions.name: Backtracking
solutions.description: Use boolean arrays for rows, columns, and boxes to track used digits. For each empty cell, try digits 1-9; if valid, place it and recurse. Backtrack on failure.

solutions.name: Backtracking with Bitmask Constraints
solutions.description: Use bitmasks for rows, columns, and boxes to track which digits are used. Collect empty cells into a list and try each digit using bitwise checks for O(1) validity testing.
